tei:div.tei:p: "$ (411)༄༅// rje btsun sgrol ma yid bzhin 'khor lo'i zab khrid thun mong ma yin pa'i yi ge bde ldan mgon po'i zhal lung ring 'tsho'i bsil sbyin zhes bya ba bzhugs so//

(412)༄༅// phun tshogs ring por 'tsho ba'i shis pa brjod pa'i rgyan gson rkyen nyer stsal zhing*// srog 'phrog la sogs dkar min bya ba rab spangs pas// byis blos bgrang bas 'dzad min tshe tshad la dbang ba// bla ma bde ldan mgon po'i shis pas skyongs shig kye// mtshan dpe'i dngos po'i dpe cha rdzogs 'dzum zhal kun phan ltar// cung zad gdangs pa'i mchu sgros bim pa bzhin// 'gro la gzigs pa'i spyan bdun utpa la'i// rjes 'gro mnga' ba yid bzhin 'khor los skyongs// thar nges pa'i dpe 'dod yongs kyi ded dpon tshar pa rje// gsang rgyud man ngag kun gyi gter gyur pa// rdo rje 'dzin pa'i rjes su 'gro las gzhan// dper 'os srid na med phyir dad phyag brtsegs// dri bcas 'gal ba'i gzugs can mtho ris lam nas ma phab cing*// gdug can drang srong lto nas bzung min pa'i// snyan brgyud gaṅgās 'tsho ba thung ba'i rgyu// mtha' dag sbyangs pa'i tshul 'di rmad kyi chos// gdams pa'i rdzas bkod pa thog ma'i gsal byed/ zin bris nyung gsal rtogs sla zhing*// zlos dang ma tshang med cing rang bzo'i dris// bslad pa min sogs khyad chos mang ldan pa// (413)grub gnyis gsos su sbyin gyis dga' bas longs// de yang bdag cag lha dang bcas pa'i 'gro ba yongs kyi ma 'dris pa'i mdza' bshes ston mchog zas gtsang sras po'i gsang chen 'bras bu'i theg pa'i rgyud sde rin po che rnams nas dus min 'chi ba las ldog cing ring 'tsho'i dngos grub sgrub pa'i thabs tshul mang du gsungs kyang*/ mdor bsdu na/ slob dpon ngag dbang grags pas// lus dang ngag gi las kyis phyi// bsam gtan las kyis nang gi yin// nor bu sman sngags phyi yi ste// rnal 'byor nus pa nang yin no// zhes gsungs pa ltar/ phyi rol bcud len sogs rdzas dang rten 'brel gto thabs tsam gyi ngal ba la ma ltos par/ nang gi rnal 'byor bsam gtan kho na gtso bor ston cing*/

bzlas brjod zung du 'brel ba rje btsun ma yid bzhin 'khor lo'i gdams pa la bod yul du brgyud pa'i bka' srol mi 'dra ba du ma zhig byung yang*/ 'dir skad gnyis smra ba'i dbang po snying rje chen po ba ri lo tsā ba nas brgyud pa gtso che zhing*/ jo bo chen po rje dang*/ kha che'i paṇḍi ta shākya shrī bha dra dang*/ gnyan lo dar ma grags nas brgyud pa rnams kyang don gyis tshang bar bzhed pa/ kun (414)gyi spyod yul du ma gyur pa'i gdams pa zab pa'i mthar thug pa 'di nyid nyams su len pa la/ sngon 'gro dang*/ dngos gzhi dang*/ rjes kyi rim pa ste gsum/ dang po la thun mong dang thun mong ma yin pa gnyis/ de'i dang po la'ang*/ lam log pa las khyad par du bya ba skyabs 'gro dang*/ lam dman pa las khyad par du bya ba sems bskyed gnyis las/ dang po la kun rdzob dang don dam pa'i skyabs 'gro gnyis/ de'i dang po la/ gang la skyabs su 'gro ba'i yul/ gang gis skyabs su 'gro ba'i gang zag /skyabs su 'gro ba'i rgyu/ ji ltar skyabs su 'gro ba'i tshul/ phan yon dang*/ bslab bya ste drug las/ dang po ni// dben pa'i gnas su khrus byas bde ba'i stan la bsam gtan gyi spyod lam dang ldan pas 'khod de/ sems gzhan du mi 'phro ba'i tshul gyis/ rang nyid gnas pa'i sa phyogs gnas khang sa rdo ri brag la sogs pa tha mal gyi snang ba thams cad dbyings su thim pa'i stong nyid kyi ngang las bai ḍūrya'i sa gzhi la gser gyi mig mang ris su bris pa/ tha gru yangs shing rgya che ba mnan na nem byed cing*/ btegs na spar byed pa/ reg na bde ba bskyed pa/ steng na 'ja' 'od kyi gur khyim phub cing*/ me tog gi char 'bebs pa ste zhing khams yongs su dag pa'i dbus su dpag bsam gyi shing lo 'dab me tog 'bras bu phun sum tshogs pa'i rtser padma 'dab ma bzhi pa'i lte bar dbus su rma byas btegs pa'i rin po che'i khri sna tshogs padma dang zla ba'i gdan gyi steng du ngo bo rang gi rtsa ba'i bla ma de nyid/

rnam pa bcom ldan 'das 'od dpag tu med pa sku mdog dmar po sprul sku'i cha lugs can/ phyag gnyis mnyam bzhag gi phyag rgya mdzad pa'i steng na bdud rtsis gang ba'i lhung bzed 'dzin pa/ mtshan dpe'i gzi byin 'bar ba/ dgyes shing 'dzum pa'i tshul can/ zhabs rdo rje'i skyil krung gis bzhugs pa/ de'i mthar mdun nas brtsams te g.yas bskor gyi sngar gyi gdan de 'dra ba chung ngu re re'i steng du brgyud pa'i bla ma rnams kyang 'od dpag (415)med kyi rnam pa can dang*/ mdun gyi 'dab ma la rje btsun ma gtso bor gyur pa'i yi dam lha tshogs rnams dang*/ g.yas kyi 'dab ma la rnam snang sogs longs sku'i cha byad can dang*/ ston pa thub pa'i dbang po la sogs pa sprul sku'i rnam pa can te sangs rgyas dkon mchog dang*/ rgyab kyi 'dab ma la ngo bo skyabs yul rnams kyi thugs rgyud la bzhugs pa'i 'gog lam gyis bsdus pa rtogs pa'i yon tan yin yang*/ rnam pa gsung rab glegs bam brag ri brtsegs pa lta bu'am sa le/ gdong dar khra bun ne yod pa ni/ chos dkon mchog dang*/ g.yon gyi 'dab ma la 'phags pa'i dge 'dun khyim pa dang rab tu byung ba'i rnam pa can rnams dang*/ mtha' skor kun tu yal 'dab kyi khrod rnams su yang mkha' 'gro chos skyong nor lha grub pa'i rig 'dzin sogs skyabs gnas su 'os so cog thams cad kyang sprin phung gtibs pa tsam sgom pa ni dge 'dun dkon mchog yin// gnyis pa ni// de rnams kyi mdun ngos su rang nyid/ g.yas su tshe 'di'i pha/ g.yon du ma/ mdun du dgra 'dre/ mtha' skor kun tu rigs drug bar do dang bcas pa'i sems can thams cad ston mo chen po la khrom tshogs pa bzhin khrig mer gyis gang bar bsam// gsum pa ni// dad pa dang*/ 'jigs pa dang*/ snying rje gsum yin la/ de'i dang po la gsum ste/ skyabs yul rnams kyi sku gsung thugs kyi yon tan la ngo mtshar zhing sems dang ba ni dang ba'i dad pa/

de lta bu'i go 'phang bdag gzhan sems can thams cad kyis thob par 'dod pa ni 'dod pa'i dad pa dang*/ skyabs yul rnams mkhyen brtse nus gsum gyi bdag nyid yin pa la yin par ngo shes shing the tshom dang yid gnyis med pa ni yid ches kyi dad pa'o// 'jigs pa la gsum ste/ 'khor ba dang ngan song gi sdug bsngal gyis 'jigs pa dang*/ rang don yid byed kyis 'jigs pa dang*/ tha mal snang zhen gyis 'jigs nas skyabs su 'gro ba'o// snying rje skyabs 'gro'i rgyur (416)gsungs pa ni sems can thams cad 'khor ba dang ngan song gi sdug bsngal bzod dka' bas mnar tshul la legs par bsam na shas mi bzod pa'i snying rje skye zhing de la brten nas sdug bsngal las skyobs 'dod kyi blo skye la/ de yang da lta rang nyid la de lta bu'i nus pa med la/ gzhan nyan rang dang 'jig rten pa'i chen po rnams la'ang med pas sems can gyi don du sangs rgyas thob 'dod dang*/ thob byed lam gyi rtsa ba yang skyabs 'gro nyid yin par shes nas skyabs su 'gro 'dod kyi blo skye ba ni theg chen kho na'i dbang du byas pa'o// bzhi pa ni// bdag gzhan sems can thams cad sgo gsum 'jug pa gcig tu dril te dus 'di nas bzung ste ji srid spang gnyen ro gcig tu gyur te bskyab bya skyob byed dang bral bar ma gyur gyi bar du ci mdzad khyed mkhyen snyam pas blo lings kyis bkal nas rang nyid kyis byang drangs te sems can thams cad kyis skyabs 'gro gu dir re byed par bsam zhing tshig rjes su sems hri li li 'brang ste skyabs 'gro bzhi skor brgya stong nas grangs med par brjod/ de yang dpal ldan bla ma zhes pa'i tshe rtsa brgyud kyi bla ma rnams la dmigs pa gtad de bdag cag gi lam sna 'dren pa po mdzad du gsol snyam pa dang*/ rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas zhes pa'i tshe mdun gyi yi dam dang g.yas kyi sangs rgyas rnams la dmigs pa gtad de bdag cag gi ston pa mdzad du gsol snyam pa dang*/

dam pa'i chos zhes pa'i tshe rgyab kyi glegs bam rnams la dmigs pa gtad de bdag cag gi lam dngos mdzad du gsol snyam pa dang*/ 'phags pa'i dge 'dun zhes pa'i tshe g.yon phyogs kyi dge 'dun dang mtha' skor gyi chos skyong sogs la dmigs pa gtad de bdag cag gi lam sgrub pa'i zla grogs mdzad du gsol snyam pa bya/ mdor na skyabs 'gros mtshon pa'i dge sbyor thams cad sems gzhan du ma yengs pa'i ngang nas gnad du smin par bya dgos/ de las ldog na byas la ma bsags pa'i las zhes ngal ba 'bras med du gsungs (417)pa'ang snying gi bum par bcang bar rigs so// mthar skyabs yul rnams kyi thugs ka nas 'od zer kha dog lnga ldan zhig 'phros te sems can rnams la phog pas sdig sgrib bag chags dang bcas pa byang zhing dag nas lus zag med 'ja' lus dang sems rtog med chos skur gyur te so so'i zhing khams su bya khyu 'phur ba bzhin song bar bsam// slar yang mos gus dung nge ba'i ngang nas thal mo sbyar te/ bla ma dang dkon mchog rin po che sogs kyis gsol ba btab pas mtha' skor gyi chos skyong sogs dgyes bzhin 'od du zhu nas dge 'dun la thim/ de chos la/ de sangs rgyas la/ de yi dam la/ de brgyud pa'i bla ma la/ de gtso bo la thim/ de yang dbu'i gtsug tor nas mar 'od du zhu/ dpag bsam gyi shing gi rtsa ba nas yar zhu ste thugs ka'i thad du 'od dmar po nyi ma bye ba'i gzi byin can snum la 'dril ba dmar la dwangs pa zhig tu gyur te rang dang je nye je nyer byung ste spyi bo nas thim pas bla ma'i sku gsung thugs dang rang sems dbyer med ro gcig tu 'dres song snyam pa yan chad kun rdzob kyi skyabs 'gro dang*/ de ga'i ngang la dang po hril gyis bsgrim/ bar du lhod kyis klod/ tha ma rang so bzung ste/ dus gsum gyi rtog pa'i rgyu 'grul chad pa'i rig pa stong gsal rjen ne ba de nyid kyi steng na skyabs gnas thams cad tshang ba yin te/

gsal ba dge 'dun/ stong pa dam chos/ zung 'jug sangs rgyas/ de gsum dbyer mi phyed pa bla ma ste rim bzhin sprul longs chos sku ngo bo nyid kyi skur thag bcad nges shes bskyed de 'dzin pa ma zhugs par rgyun bskyang ba ni don dam pa'i skyabs 'gro'o// phan yon dang bslab bya ni theg pa chen po'i skabs dang bstan bcos rnams nas 'byung ba bzhin nges par byas la mi 'gal bar bslab par bya'o// gnyis pa sems bskyed la kun rdzob dang don dam pa'i byang chub sems sgom pa gnyis/ dang po la smon 'jug gnyis las/ smon pa (418)sems bskyed pa ni 'di ltar nges par bya ste/ nam mkha' la mtha' med pa bzhin du sems can la mtha' med/ mtha' med pa'i sems can re res kyang rang nyid kyi pha ma yang yang byas shing*/ byas res kyis phan tshad med pa btags/ gnod pa mtha' dag las skyob pa'i drin can sha stag yin/ 'di rnams 'dod pa bde ba 'dod kyang de sgrub pa'i thabs la mi mkhas pas la la ni sdug bsngal dngos la longs spyod/ la la ni sdug bsngal gyi rgyu mi dge ba rngams po che la longs spyod/ ma rig pa'i ling thog gis mig ldongs/ thar pa'i rten gyi 'khar ba dang bral/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyi dmigs bus ma zin/ mtho ris dang thar pa'i lam la brdeg 'chos shing ngan song gsum gyi g.yang khar 'grim pa 'di rnams snying re rje/ snying rje'o byas nas bzhag pas mi phan sdug bsngal las bsgral nas bde ba la 'god dgos/ de'i nus pa da lta bdag la med/ bdag las lhag pa'i tshangs pa dang brgya byin la sogs pa 'jig rten pa'i chen po dang*/ nyan rang la sogs pa 'phags pa'i khongs su gtogs pa 'ga' zhig la'ang med/ su la yod na rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kho na la yod de/ khong gi sku las 'od zer re spros pa dang*/ chos thun re gsungs pas kyang 'gro ba dpag tu med pa 'khor ba las sgrol bar nus pas/ bdag gis kyang sems can thams cad kyi don du rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang de ci nas kyang thob par bya snyam du yang yang bsams la/

sems can thams cad kyi don du zhes sogs brjod/ gnyis pa 'jug pa'i sems bskyed ni/ de lta bu'i go 'phang de yang*/ skye bo phal pa dge ba mi byed pa lta bu rgyu med pa dang*/ mu stegs byed lta bu rgyu log pa dang*/ nyan rang lta bu rgyu ma tshang ba la mi 'byung bas/ tshang la ma nor bar rgyal ba sras dang bcas pas bgrod pa gcig pa'i lam theg chen thun mong dang thun mong ma yin pa'i thabs la ci nus kyi bslabs shing*/ khyad par rje btsun ma sgrol ma (419)dkar mo yid bzhin 'khor lo'i sgom bzlas zab mo nyams su blang snyam du bsams la de'i ched du rje btsun sgrol ma dkar mo zhes sogs brjod pa yan kun rdzob sems bskyed dang*/ gnyis pa ni/ sems bskyed bya skyed byed thams cad kyang rang bzhin gyi mi dmigs par bsams pa ni don dam pa'i sems bskyed yin zhes gsungs// gnyis pa thun mong ma yin pa'i sngon 'gro la bsod nams kyi tshogs bsags pa dang*/ ye shes kyi tshogs bsags pa gnyis/ dang po la yul dag pa la brten pa dang*/ ma dag pa la brten pa gnyis/ de'i dang po la tshogs zhing spyan drangs pa dang*/ tshogs gsogs pa dngos so// dang po ni/ rang skad cig gis rje btsun mar gsal ba'i thugs kar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du tām̐ yig dkar po langs thabs su gnas pa las 'od zer 'phros lus kyi nang thams cad gang*/ sdig sgrib bag chags dang bcas pa dang*/ khyad par tshogs zhing mthong ba la sgrib byed kyi las nyon bag chags dang bcas pa sbyangs nas rlung sna bug g.yas nas phyir rgyu ba dang bstun 'od zer phyir 'phros pas rang bzhin gyi gnas nas rje btsun ma bla ma 'od dpag med kyis dbur brgyan pa la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs kyis bskor ba mdun gyi nam mkhar rdo rje bsdu ba'i sngags dang phyag rgyas spyan drangs/ de yang rgyal ba rnams rang bzhin gyi sku skye 'gags gnas gsum gshegs bzhud bzhugs gsum gyi spros pa dang bral ba mkha' dbyings khyab par lhun grub 'du 'bral med par bzhugs pa la 'od zer gyis phog pas gsal bar byas pa la rang bzhin gyi gnas sam chos sku'i zhing khams nas spyan drangs zhes tha snyad byas pa yin/

gnyis pa tshogs bsags pa dngos ni/ phyag 'tshal ba/ mchod pa 'bul ba/ sdom pa bzung ba ste gsum las/ dang po ni/ rang lus zhing gi rdul gyi grangs mnyam du sprul nas phyag 'tshal bar bsam zhing*/ thal mo sbyar te/ na mo gu ru bhyaḥ zhes pas bla ma dang*/ na ma ārya tā ra (420)sogs kyis yi dam 'khor bcas la phyag byas par bsam/ gnyis pa ni// rang gi snying ga nas spros pa'i 'od zer gyi rtse mo las mchod pa'i lha mo lang tsho dar la babs pa dar dang rin po che'i rgyan gyis spud pa mang por sprul te/ de yang lha mo dkar mos phyag na dung phor yan lag brgyad ldan gyi chu gtsang me tog dkar po dang bcas pas gang bar thogs te tshogs zhing rnams kyi phyag tu 'bul ba dang*/ lha mo dmar mos dung phor dang ril ba dang bya ma bum sogs dri bzang gis sbags pa'i chus bkang ba thogs te zhabs bsil ba dang*/ yang lha mo dkar mos thang las skyes pa dang*/ chu las skyes pa'i me tog gi bye brag mtshar zhing dri bsung dang ldan pas bkang ba'i za ma tog thogs te dbu la 'thor bzhin pa dang*/ lha mo dud khas lhan cig skyes pa dang sbyar ba'i bdug spos dri zhim po'i reng bu dang spos phor sogs thogs te shangs la 'bul ba dang*/ lha mo dmar skyas nyi zla'i dkyil 'khor dang*/ me shel dang*/ nor bu rin po che dang*/ mar me'i sdong bu'i 'od kyis nyi zla yang mog mog por byed pa sogs snang gsal gyi rigs thogs te spyan lam du ngom bzhin pa dang*/ lha mo ljang gus ga bur dang*/ tsan dan dang*/ gur gum sogs bsil sman sna tshogs btab pa'i chus bkang ba'i dung phor thogs te thugs kar byugs pa dang 'thor yab kyis sku la 'thor ba dang*/ lha mo dmar mos lha dang mi yi zas bzang dgu ro brgya dang ldan pas bkang ba'i rin po che'i gzhong ba thogs te ljags la 'bul bzhin pa dang*/ lha mo sngon mos lha yi sil snyan dang*/ pi wang dang gling bu dang pheg rdob dang rdza rnga dang rnga zlum sogs rol mo'i bye brag kun snyan lam du 'khrol bas tshogs zhing rnams kyi thugs rgyud zag med kyi bde bas mnyes par bsams la so so'i phyag rgya dang bcas/

oṃ gu ru ārya tā re sa pā ri wā ra ārghaṃ nas/ shabda āḥhūm̐ bar brjod/ lha mo rnams tshur 'dus rang gi thugs ka'i sa bon la thim par bsam/ gsum pa sdom pa bzung ba ni/ rdo rje thal mor sbyar ba snying khar bzhag ste/ don yid la dran (421)bzhin pas gur nas 'byung ba'i rgyun bshags lan gsum bya/ de yang dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi/ zhes pas rten gyi stobs te tshogs zhing rnams so// sdig pa thams cad so sor bshags// zhes pas sngar byas kyi sdig pa la 'gyod pa drag po bskyed pa rnam par sun 'byin pa'i stobs dngos su bstan la/ phyin chad srog la babs kyang mi byed snyam du sdom pa gnyen po kun tu spyod pa'i stobs dang*/ de ltar byas pas sdig sgrib ji ltar che yang dag nges snyam pa sor chud pa'i stobs gnyis shugs las bstan pa sdig pa bshags pa'i yan lag dang*/ 'gro ba'i dge la rjes yi rang*/ zhes pas 'khor 'das dus gsum gyis bsdus pa'i dge ba la dga' zhing phrag dog med pa ni rjes su yi rang ba'i yan lag dang*/ sangs rgyas byang chub yid kyis bzung*// zhes pas sangs rgyas thams cad kyis nye bar brten pa'i don dam byang chub kyi sems stong nyid snying rje'i snying po can de bdag gis kyang bsgom par bgyi'o snyam pa don dam byang chub kyi sems bzung ba'i yan lag dang*/ sangs rgyas chos dang tshogs mchog sogs tshig rkang gnyis kyis skyabs 'gro'i yan lag dang*/ rang gzhan don ni zhes sogs tshig rkang gnyis kyis smon pa sems bskyed dang*/ byang chub mchog gi sogs tshig rkang gsum gyis 'jug pa sems bskyed kyi yan lag bstan te gong du bshad pa ltar ro// 'gro la phan phyir sangs rgyas 'grub par shog /ces pas de ltar bgyis pa'i dge bas sems can thams cad kyi don du sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob par shog cig snyam pas bsngo ba'i yan lag rnams bstan to// de ltar byas pas tshogs zhing rnams dgyes bzhin du 'od du zhu nas rang la thim par bsam mo// gnyis pa yul ma dag pa la brten nas tshogs bsags pa ni/

yul tshad med pa mkha' khyab kyi sems can la dmigs te bsam pa tshad med pa ris sam phyogs su ma (422)lhung ba bsgom pas na tshad med dam/ gnas skabs kyi 'bras bu gzugs khams kyis tshangs pa'am/ mthar thug gi 'bras bu sangs rgyas la tshangs pa'i sgras bshad pa'ang 'di nyid bsgoms pa las 'byung bas na tshangs pa'i gnas zhes bya ste/ bsgom pa'i tshul ni/ sems can thams cad yid yul du byas te/ 'di rnams bde ba dang bde ba'i rgyu dge ba bcu spyod pa'i skal ba dang ldan na ci ma rung snyam pa 'dun pa dang 'brel ba/ de dang ldan pa zhig bdag gis bya'o snyam pa'i dam bca' dang 'brel ba/ de bzhin du gyur cig snyam pa smon lam dang 'brel ba/ de bzhin tu 'gyur ba bla ma dang dkon mchog mkhyen snyam pa gsol 'debs dang 'brel ba ste gzhan gsum la'ang 'gre shes par byas la tshig tsam ma yin par zhe thag pa nas bsam zhing sems can thams cad bde ba dang bde ba'i rgyu dang ldan pa sogs brjod par bya'o// khrid kyi sngon 'gro'i skabs sogs su 'di kho na bzhin bya yi rgyun du ni tshig ris dang mthun pa smon lam dang 'brel ba tsam gyis chog go /gnyis pa ye shes kyi tshogs bsags pa ni/ gcig du bral gyi rig pas dpyad pa stong nyid bshigs nas bsgom pa dang*/ sngags kyis stong par sbyangs pa btsan thabs su bsgom pa gnyis las phyi ma nyid skabs su babs te/ de la'ang snang bcas su bsgom pa dang snang med du bsgom pa gnyis yod pa las lha dang gzhal yas khang sgom pa'i phyogs la phyi ma nyid legs par bzhed/ de yang swa bhā wa sogs sngags brjod pa tsam gyis snang srid 'khor 'das kyis bsdus pa'i chos thams cad nam mkha' la du ba yal ba bzhin 'od gsal stong pa nyid kyi ngang du thim par bsams la rang sems stong pa nam mkha' gsum po ro gcig tu 'dres pa'i rig stong rjen ne ba de ga'i ngang la hril gyis bsgrim/ lhod kyis glod/

rang sor bzung ba spel mar byas te ci gnas su mnyam par 'jog pa ni gnad kyi don te 'og nas 'byung ba'i lam thams cad kyang rmi lam sgyu ma lta bur shes nas zhen pa (423)rang grol du 'gyur ba dang*/ gong 'og gi thabs kyi cha thams cad kyang shes rab dang zung 'brel du 'gyur ba dang*/ stong nyid kyi ngang las lhar bzhengs pas 'bras dus su sku gnyis phrin las dang bcas pa 'bad med lhun grub tu rdzogs pa'i dgos pa yod do// ༈ /spyi don gnyis pa dngos gzhi'i rim pa la// thun mong du lha bsgom pa dang*/ 'di nyid kyi thun mong ma yin pa'i dmigs pa'i zab khyad rnams bsgom pa dang gnyis kyi/ dang po la bla ma dag gi bzhed pas bya ba can gyi bskyed rim dang*/ byed pa can gyi bskyed rim zhes rnal 'byor bla med kyi khrid gzhung chen po rnams dang 'gros mthun par mdzad kyang*/ don la yan lag bzhi rdzogs kyi cho gas lha yi skur bsgom pa dang*/ de nyid la gsal snang khyad par can skye ba'i phyir rim bzhin sems bzung ba gnyis las/ dang po ni/ rang lhar bsgoms pa'i thad der pam̐ yig dkar po zhig thol gyis byung ba yongs su gyur pa las padma dkar po 'dab ma brgyad pa ze'u 'bru ljang gu/ ge sar dmar ser kha bye ma thag pa lta bu de'i lte bar a yig dkar po yongs su gyur pa las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor 'od zer 'phros pa dang bcas pa shel dkar gyi me long kha sbubs pa lta bu/ de'i steng du rang gi rnam shes kyi ngo bo tām̐ yig dkar po de las 'od zer 'phros zhes pa nas/ 'od kor can zhes pa'i bar shar sgom gyi tshul du nyams su len pa ni bsnyen pa'i yan lag go /de'i spyi bor oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par āḥdamar po/ thugs kar hūm̐ sngon po rnams sangs rgyas thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs rdo rje'i ngo bor bsams pa ni nyer sgrub kyi yan lag go /thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros/

zhes pa nas/ gnyis su med par thim zhes pa'i bar ni sgrub pa'i yan lag go /slar yang 'od zer 'phros pas dbang lha spyan drangs nas gsol ba btab/ dbang bskur zhing rigs kyi bdag pos rgyas btab te dbang lha rnams kyang rigs bdag la (424)thim par bsam pa ni/ sgrub pa chen po'i yan lag go /de nas rang gi snying ga'i sa bon las sprul pa'i lha mo rnams kyis rang nyid la mchod pa byed par bsams la mtshan sngags sngon du 'gro ba'i chu gnyis nyer spyod lngas mchod/ lha mo de rnams kyis bstod par bsam zhing*/ 'khor ba las sgrol sogs kyis bstod nas lha mo rnams rang gi thugs kar thim par bsam mo// gnyis pa sems 'dzin gyi rim pa la/ nga rgyal la bslab pa dang*/ rnam pa la bslab pa gnyis las/ dang po ni/ nga ni tha mal pa nam yang ma yin te skyon kun zad yon tan kun rdzogs 'bras dus sangs rgyas kyi sa mngon du mdzad kyang 'gro ba bud med kyis 'dul ba la gzigs nas shes rab lha mo'i skur bzhengs pa rje btsun ma sgrol ma yid bzhin 'khor lo dngos yin snyam pa'i nga rgyal tu btud po de ka la dang po hril gyis bsgrim/ bar du de tsam du mi 'dzin par lhod kyis glod/ de ltar grim lhod ran pos shes pa rang so bzung ste 'dzin med kyi lta bas rgyas 'debs pa ni gnad dam pa yin no// gnyis pa ni// bla med kyi khrid gzhung chen po rnams su rnam pa spyi dang bye brag la sems bzung ba sogs sa bcad mang du mdzad kyang*/ 'dir ni spyi yi sems 'dzin rgyas tsam las mi mdzad pas/ nga rgyal la sems bzung ba de ka'i ngang las slar yang nga nyid sgrol ma dngos yin na de yang rnam pa 'di lta bu ste/ sku mdog ston ka'i zla ba ltar dkar zhing nor bu chu shel dri ma med pa ltar dwangs shing 'od 'phro ba/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyan gsum dang ldan pa/ lang tsho bcu drug lon pa'i na tshod can/ mdzes sdug gi phul du byung bas drang srong rnams kyi brtan pa'ang 'phrog par nus pa/

mnyen lcugs dang ldan pa'i phyag gnyis kyi g.yas pa pus mo'i steng du mchog sbyin gyi phyag rgya dang*/ g.yon pas utpal dkar po'i yu ba mtheb srin sbyar bas thugs kar bzung ba'i 'dab ma snyan gyi thad kar rtsa ba gcig la rtse mo gsum du gyes pa'i dbus (425)kyi me tog da ltar gyi sangs rgyas rnams mtshon pa'i brdar kha bye ba/ g.yas kyi me tog 'das pa'i sangs rgyas rnams mtshon pa'i brdar 'bras bu'i tshul du yod pa/ g.yon gyi me tog ma 'ongs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams mtshon pa'i brdar gong bu ste kha ma bye ba'i tshul du yod pa/ smin mtshams su spyan dbu ma dbus nag pa/ mtha' skya ba/ spyan rtsa yid tsam dmar ba/ dkyus ring zhing zim bur gzigs pa/ spyan g.yon pa gyen du bskrangs pa lta bu/ ba mchog gi rdzi ma lta bus mdzes shing smin ma dang bcas pa/ g.yas g.yon gyi spyan gnyis kyang de dang 'dra ba/ shangs gangs ri'i zur ltar legs pa'i nang nas utpa la'i dri bsung 'thul ba/ snyan gnyis snyan shal ring ba/ mchu'i sgros legs shing bimba ltar dmar ba/ ljags srab cing mnyen pa/ tshems bzhi bcu tham pa dkar zhing thags bzang ba/ zur bzhir mche ba'i myu gu cung zad dang bcas pa/ mgul pa bum pa ltar zlum zhing gnyer ma gsum dang bcas pa/ dbu skra mthon mthing ral pa'i zur phud ltag par bcings pa'i lan bu ring du 'phyang ba/ 'phrang zhing rgyas pa'i nu 'bur zung gis mdzes pa/ sku stod tsho skem ran pa/ sked skabs phra ba/ sku smad shes rab kyi rang bzhin rgyas pa/ gsang ba'i padma rus sbal gyi rgyab ltar mtho zhing mdzes pa/ phyag zhabs kyi mthil rnams pa la sha ltar 'jam pa'i dbus su spyan re re yod pa/ sor mo rnams ngang pa ltar drwa bas 'brel ba/ dbu rgyan ni srog zhu rim pa gsum rin po che'i rtse bran nam ze srog lnga'i rtsa ba nas bai ḍūrya'i 'khyud mos bsdoms shing rna ltag gnyis su utpal rgyas pa las dar dpyangs 'phyang ba/

snyan rgyan ni rin po che'i rna kor zlum po la phra tshom gyis mdzes pa/ mgul rgyan ni g.yas g.yon dbus gsum du rin po che'i gzhung gsum gyi bar drwa bas sbrel ba mgul par 'khyil pa'i tshul du yod pa/ phyag gdub ni rin po che'i gzhung gsum gyi drwa bar dwa bas sbrel (426)ba che ba gnyis kyis dpung pa dang*/ chung ba gnyis kyis mkhrig mar brgyan pa/ zhabs gdub de dang 'dra ba la smad du rin po che'i zar tshags mang po 'phyang bas long bur brgyan pa'o// 'og pags sam rked rgyan ni rin po che'i gzhung lnga gyen du byas pa'i bar drwa bas sbrel zhing zur du rin po che'i chun 'phyang mang pos spras pa/ do shal ni rin po che'i phreng bas mgul nas lte ba'i 'og yan 'khor ba/ se mo do ni de las thung ba nu ma yan 'khor ba ste brgyad yin la/ drug tu bshad pa ni gdu bu rnams gcig tu brtsis/ do shal dang se mo do gcig tu brtsis pa'o// dar sna tshogs kyi stod g.yogs dang dar dmar po'i sham thabs gsol ba/ zhabs rdo rje'i skyil krung gis bzhugs pa/ zla ba'i dkyil 'khor la rgyab brten cing*/ 'od kor dang 'od zer gyi phreng ba mu med pa 'phro bzhin pa dang gnas gsum gyi yi ge gsum rigs bdag dang bcas pa la rim bzhin sems bzung*/ de yang gong bzhin sgrim lhod res 'jog gi tshul du bslab cing mthar lhar zhen pa'i a 'thas des sangs rgyas thob pa'i gegs kyang byed srid pas 'dzin stangs hring hring po de yang gshigs nas dmigs med kyi lta bas rgyas btab cing skyong ba ni gtso che ste/ rgya gzhung rnams su yang lha yi sku snang la rang bzhin med pa la sems yun ring du bltas la zhes sogs gsungs pa'i phyir ro// gnyis pa 'di nyid kyi thun mong ma yin pa'i dmigs pa la/ thugs ka'i 'khor lo bsgom pa/ rigs bdag 'pho ba/ srung 'khor bsgom pa/ tshe bcud bsdu ba/ sngags bzlas pa'i dmigs pa rnams la/

dang po ni/ rang nyid rje btsun ma'i sku snang la rang bzhin med pa/ me long nang gi gzugs brnyan lta bur gsal ba'i thugs kar te nu ma gnyis kyi bar gyi thad sgal tshigs la nya ba'i gnas der rgyu zla ba las grub pa'i chos kyi 'khor lo dkar po rtsibs brgyad pa/ dbyibs leb chags la lte ba dang rtsibs dang mu khyud rnams khrol tshags kyi rnam pa can gyi lte ba'i dbus su tām̐ (427)yig dkar po/ de'i mtha' skor du ma ma āḥyu puṇya dzñā na puṣṭiṃ ku ru zhes g.yas skor dang*/ tām̐ yig gi mdun ngos spel tshig gi phyi rol du oṃ/ rgyab tu hā/ rtsibs brgyad so so'i dbus su rim bzhin ta re tutta re tu re swā/ zhes pa'i yig 'bru re yod pa rnams kha dog dkar po dang*/ de'i phyi rol gyi mu khyud nang ma la a ā i ī u ū ṛ ṝ l̥ l̥̄ e ai o au aṃ aḥrnams kha dog dkar po g.yon skor du yod pa/ de'i phyi rol gyi mu khyud la ka kha ga gha nga nas ha kṣa'i bar du kha dog dkar la dmar mdangs can g.yas skor dang*/ de'i phyi rol gyi mu khyud la ye dharmā'i sngags phreng kha dog dkar po g.yas skor du yod pa ste sngags phreng thams cad kyang langs thabs kyi rnam pa can/ de'i phyi rol gyi mu khyud la rdo rje sngon po'i phreng ba phyed mu khyud la nub cing phyed yar 'greng bur thon pa/ de'i phyi rol du 'od zer sna lnga'i phreng ba g.yas bskor du yod par bsam// gnyis pa ni// spyi bo'i bla ma 'od dpag med yongs su gyur pa las/ mgon po tshe dang ye shes dpag tu med pa sku mdog dkar la dmar ba'i mdangs chags pa/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis kyis gser gyi bum pa 'chi med bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun gyis gang ba mnyam bzhag gi steng na 'dzin pa/ dar dang rin po che'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa/ zhabs rdo rje'i skyil krung gis bzhugs pa zhig tu gnas par gyur bar bsam// gsum pa ni// rang nyid kyi phyi rol tu 'khor lo dkar po sbubs can zhwa thebs kha sbyar ba lta bu/

rtse rim gyis rno ba/ g.yas skor du 'khor ba las me dpung 'bar zhing 'khrugs pas gdon bgegs thams cad bya sgro mgar gyi so lam du babs pa ltar gzhob thul thul du tshig par bsam// de nas snying ga'i hūm̐ yig sngags phreng dang bcas pa las 'od zer dkar po zla ba stong dus gcig tu shar ba lta bu 'phros/ lus kyi nang thams cad gang*/ nad gdon sdig sgrib thams cad byang zhing dag /ba spu'i bu ga nas phyir 'phros/ 'khor lo'i gur khang gi phyi rol 'dom gang (428)tsam du 'od dkar po'i gur khang du gyur/ zhi ba'i phrin las thams cad 'grub par bsam/ yang snying ga'i yig 'bru rnams las 'od zer ser po gser zhun ma lta bu 'phros/ lus kyi nang thams cad gang*/ tshe dang bsod nams dang ye shes thams cad rgyas par byas/ ba spu'i bu ga nas phyir 'phros 'od dkar po'i gur khang gi phyi rol 'dom gang tsam du 'od ser po'i gur khang du gyur/ rgyas pa'i phrin las thams cad 'grub par bsam// yang snying ga'i sngags phreng las 'od dmar po bye ru'i mdog lta bu 'phros/ lus kyi nang thams cad gang*/ brtan g.yo snod bcud thams cad dbang du bsdus/ ba spu'i bu ga nas phyir 'phros/ 'od ser po'i gur khar gi phyi rol 'dom gang tsam du 'od dmar po'i gur khang du gyur// dbang gi phrin las thams cad 'grub par bsam// yang snying ga'i sngags phreng las 'od zer mthing ga 'phros/ lus kyi nang thams cad gang*/ mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad tshar bcad/ ba spu'i bu ga nas phyir 'phros/ 'od dmar po'i gur khang gi phyi rol 'dom gang tsam du 'od mthing ga'i gur khang du gyur// drag po'i phrin las thams cad 'grub par bsam/ yang snying ga'i sngags phreng las 'od zer ljang gu margad zhu ba'i mdog lta bu 'phros/ lus kyi nang thams cad gang*/ mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub thams cad gcig char du 'grub par byas/ ba spu'i bu ga nas phyir 'phros/

'od mthing ga'i gur khang gi phyi rol 'dom gang tsam du 'od ljang gu'i gur khang du gyur/ phrin las thams cad 'grub par bsam/ yang sngags phreng las 'od zer mchin kha 'phros/ lus kyi nang thams cad gang*/ byin rlabs dang dngos grub thams cad brtan par byas/ ba spu'i bu ga nas phyir 'phros/ 'od ljang gu'i gur khang gi phyi rol 'dom gang tsam du 'od mchin kha'i gur khang du gyur/ byin rlabs dang phrin las thams cad brtan par bsam/ 'od kyi gur khang drug po thams cad kyang dbyibs (429)sgo nga'i rnam pa lta bu dum bu gcig tu gyur pa sra zhing mkhregs pa bskal pa'i rlung gis kyang gzhig par mi nus par bar mtshams thams cad utpal sngon po'i me tog kha bye ma thag pa gsar zhing mnyen lcugs dang ldan pas bun long gis gtams par bsam mo// de nas tām̐ yig gis skor gyi nang du rang gi bla ma zhal bzhugs pa rnams sku bsgres gzhon bsnyun tshul bstan pa sogs ji ltar yin kyang skabs 'dir sku'i rnam pa can de ka yin pa la gzhon tshul lang tsho rgyas shing na bza' sogs kyang gzab 'phyor gyi rnam pa can du bsgom pa rten 'brel gyi dgos pa dang*/ bsgrub bya gtso che ba de tām̐ yig gi 'og pa'i nang dang*/ gzhan rnams g.yas g.yon gang bder so so'i rnam pa gzhon tshul gzab 'phyor can du bsgom/ 'og gi tshe bcud bstim pa'i dmigs pa sogs tshar nas ngo bo de dang de yin pa la rnam pa rdo rje sngon po rtse lnga gyen 'greng gi lte bar hūm̐ yig sngon pos mtshan pa re gsal 'debs/ de yang rdo rjes ni sku/ hūm̐ de spyir yi ge yin pas gsung*/ bye brag tu sangs rgyas thams cad kyi thugs kyi sa bon yin pas bsgrub bya'i lus ngag yid gsum rdo rje gsum gyi ngo bor rgyas btab par 'gro bas shin tu zab ces gsung sgros zin bris kha cig las 'byung ngo*// de dag brtan pa'i phyir thugs ka'i 'khor lo dang*/

spyi bo'i rigs bdag nas 'od mchin kha'i bar rim bzhin gsal btab/ yang phyi rol nas tshur rim bzhin gsal 'debs pa sems 'dzin dang cha 'dra ba'i sgo nas gsal snang khyad par can ma thon gyi bar du 'bad par bya'o// bzhi pa ni/ spyi bo'i bla ma tshe dpag med la mos gus dung dung pa zhig byas pas de'i thugs ka'i hrīḥyig las 'od zer lcags kyu lta bu phyogs thams cad du bun gyis 'phros pas snod kyi 'jig rten ri gling nyi zla sogs 'byung ba bzhi'i bcud dwangs ma bkrag mdangs gzi brjid nus mthu thams cad dang*/ bcud kyi sems can mkhas pa (430)paṇḍi ta dang*/ grub pa rigs 'dzin/ tshe'i dngos grub brnyes pa'i lha dang drang srong gi tshogs thams cad dang*/ lha klu gnod sbyin dri za mkha' lding la sogs pa'i mi ma yin mthu bo che rnams dang*/ 'khor los bsgyur ba'i rgyal po/ khams kyi rgyal phran sogs mi yi bdag po rnams dang*/ gzhan yang rigs drug gi bsdus pa'i sems can thams cad kyi tshe dang bsod nams dpal 'byor dang*/ gzi brjid dbang thang thams cad 'od zer kha dog lnga ldan gyi rnam par bsdus te phyag gi bum pa'i nang du zhugs/ slar yang 'od zer 'phros pas phyogs bcu rab 'byams mu mtha' med pa'i zhing khams na bzhugs pa'i rgyal ba'i dbang po sras dang slob mar bcas pa thams cad dang*/ khyad par du yang 'jig rten gyi khams bde ba can dang yon tan dpag tu med pa la sogs pa na bzhugs pa'i mgon po tshe dang ye shes dpag tu med pa'i lha tshogs rnams dang*/ ri bo po tā la dang seng ldeng gi nags khrod sogs na bzhugs pa'i rje btsun ma 'khor dang bcas pa'i thugs kar phog pas thugs rgyud bskul/ thugs gnyis su med pa'i ye shes mkhyen brtse nus pa'i yon tan rnams dang 'chi med tshe yi dngos grub thams cad 'od zer gyi rnam par spyan drangs te/ phyag gi bum pa'i nang du zhugs/ de nyid gyen du phyur zhing kha nas mar zhom gyis lud pa gzhan du bo zegs med par rang gi spyi bo tshangs pa'i bu ga nas mar zhugs lus kyi nang thams cad mer gyis khengs/

bdag dang bsgrub bya rnams kyi tshe dang bsod nams ye shes dpal 'byor gzi brjid lung rtogs kyi yon tan thams cad rgyas par byas nas 'chi ba med pa'i tshe/ rgud pa med pa'i lang tsho/ rtag brtan gzhom gzhig bral ba 'gyur med rdo rje'i lus su gyur par bsam zhing*/ lus gnad bsrang*/ lag pa g.yas g.yon gang bde'i gung mo brkyangs pa'i rgyab tu mdzub mo bkug ste sbyar/ srin lag dang mthe'u chung lag mthil du bkug la mthe bos mnan pa rdo rje phyed pa'i phyag rgyas sna bug g.yas (431)bkag ste g.yon nas rlung ro mgo mjug phra la dbus sbom pa nas 'dra zhig sangs kyis 'bud/ yang g.yon pa bkag la g.yas nas de bzhin 'bud/ yang gnyis ka nas mnyam du 'bud/ de nas 'og rlung snyan gsan 'bebs tshul du phyed 'then tsam byas/ steng rlung sa len ma'i tshul du rdzogs par rngubs shing rlung gi rta mchil ma zhig mid pa dang mnyam du lte 'og tu mnan/ slar yang 'og rlung rdzogs par 'then te kha sbyor gyi tshul du bzung*/ mi thub na dal bus btang*/ yang gong 'og gi dmigs pa rnams gsal ba'i ngang nas bzung*/ de lta bu'i bum can gsum nas nyer gcig gi bar dmigs pa dang sbrag cing ci thub bzung ngo*// lnga pa ni// thugs ka'i 'khor lo sngags phreng dang bcas pa las kyang 'chi med bdud rtsi'i zil dngar gyi rgyun dang*/ 'od zer dkar po sngags kyi sgra sgrogs pa'i tshogs dpag tu med pa 'phros/ rang gi lus kyi rkang mthil nas spyi gtsug gi bar mer gyis gang bas/ nad gdon sdig sgrib thams cad dang khyad par du dus ma yin par 'chi ba'i rgyu tshe rabs gzhan du srog bcad pa dang*/ tshe thung bar 'gyur ba'i rgyu gzhan gyis 'tsho ba'i rkyen 'phrog pa la sogs pa'i las ngan thams cad sbyangs/ 'chi ba med pa tshe yi dngos grub thob/ ba spu'i bu ga thams cad kyang bdud rtsi'i zil pa mukti ka'i dog pa'am skar ma'i phreng ba lta bu khra chem chem pas bkag par bsams la rgyas pa'i las mthun gyi phreng ba'am/

ma 'byor na las thams cad la bo de tse kho nas rung ba rgyud kyi dgongs pa klan ka dang bral ba yin pas de lta bu'i phreng ba grangs brgya rtsa brgyad yod nges gcig snyem par bzung ste/ oṃ ru tsi ra ma ṇi pra wardha na ye swā hā/ zhes lan ji ltar rigs pas sngags la g.yon pa'i mthe bong lcags kyus dngos grub 'gugs par bsam zhing gung mo'i steng nas bgrang*/ myur ches pa la sogs pa'i skyon brgyad spangs te sems gzhan du ma yengs pas sngags kyi grangs brgya rtsa brgyad nas stong gi bar ci nus su bzla'o// bzla bya'i sngags ni yi ge bcu pa (432)spel tshig can kho na'o// gang dag bsgrub bya'i rim gro lta bu'i bsnyen pa'i tshe ma ma zhes pa'i tshab tu gu ru dang dā na pa ti sogs ming dngos rgya skad du byas nas 'jug dgos tshul smra ba ni bab col tsam ste/ dkyus kyi ma ma zhes pa ni ming la rnam dbye byin nas tshig tu grub pa ste/ bdag gi zhes pa 'gyur bas mtshon na bla ma'i zhes pa dang sbyin bdag gi zhes pa lta bu rnam dbye dang bcas pa 'don dgos par 'gyur bas brda sprod la ma sbyangs pa dag gis bsnyen pa byed mi rung bar thal ba'i skyon 'babs so// mang du smras pas ci zhig bya ste gong gi bsgrub bya sba pa'i dmigs pa ma chad par byas la rang sems dang bsgrub bya'i sems gnyis ka'i ngo bo blo 'das brjod bral du ro gcig par shes par byas la 'dzin med du yang yang 'jog pa nyid kyis don 'grub par brgyud ldan bla ma'i gsung gi bdud rtsi ngan rtog gi dug chus ma bslad pa yin pas yid ches par bya'o// spyi don gsum pa rjes kyi rim pa ni// gong gi dmigs pa dang bcas pas mchod bstod byas la 'dod pa'i don la gsol ba gdab pa/ dbyangs gsal/ rten 'brel snying po/ rdo rje sems dpa'i yig brgya rnams lan gsum re bzlas pas/ sgom bzlas kyi byin rlabs brtan par bsam mo// gong gi dmigs pa dang bcas pas mchod bstod byas la/

de nas thugs ka'i tāṃ yig las 'od zer 'phros/ snod bcud thams cad la phogs pas/ de rnams 'od du zhu nas/ 'od mchin kha'i gur khang la thim/ de ljang gu'i/ de mthing ga'i/ de dmar po'i/ de ser po'i/ de dkar po'i/ de 'khor lo'i gur khang la/ de rang nyid/ rang yang stod smad nas rim bzhin 'od du zhu nas/ thugs ka'i 'khor lo sngags phreng dang bcas pa la/ de tām̐ yig la/ de'i khog pa mgo bo la/ de zla tshes la/ de thig le la/ de nā da la thim/ de yang mi dmigs par bsam la 'dzin med du 'jog go /slar yang stong nyid de'i ngang nas chu las nya ldang ba bzhin lha'i skur langs la gnas gsum (433)yi ge gsum gyis bsrung*/ dge ba 'di yis myur du bdag /yid bzhin 'khor lo 'grub gyur nas// zhes sogs kyis bsngo ba dang shis brjod byas la bun mtshams thams cad du snang grags rig gsum rje btsun ma'i gsang ba gsum gyi ngo bor shes par bya zhing dkon mchog mchod pa/ bla ma dang dge 'dun la bsnyen bskur/ satstsha gdab ba/ gtor ma btang ba/ phyag dang bskor ba/ mdo bklag pa/ gsod par nges pa'i sems can gyi srog slu ba/ zas skom yo byad sogs 'tsho ba'i rkyen ster ba ste mdor na chos mthun gyi bya ba kho nas dus 'da' bar bya'o// de rnams kyis rje btsun ma yid bzhin 'khor lo'i zab khrid thun mong ma yin pa yongs su rdzogs pa rgyas bsdus mtshams pa'i dag gis bstan zin te// slar smras pa/ 'di ko 'gro la 'doms rnams

de nyid brjod pa'i dpe mkhas dang grub/ rim par byon gyi skya bseng rgyal brgyud min// 'khrul med gdams pa yid can ring 'tsho'i gsos// yin gyi mi tshe 'da' ba'i sgrung rgyud min// rgyu des utpal bzhin dad sgrol mkhyen pa'i rol sgeg las/ sbrang rtsi'i bcud bzhin brten 'os snyan brgyud thun mong min pa'i mchog /ra mig gnyis pa ji bzhin bdag blo'i mos pas yongs blangs pa// brjod pas 'jigs phyir gsung rgyun ji bzhin nyams med brtson pas spel/ ngag don dpe las bzhin sgra du ma can/ /'on te bdag blo'i bung ba lhan skyes 'thib bu'i ma bsdus pa'i gzugs can bum nang du// ring nas byong bslad 'khor ba'i bag chags stug po'i mthu brtas pas/ spyi brtol ldab ldib dbyangs su blangs la 'gal dang ma 'brel dang*// zlos pa'i skyon sogs gang mchis mkhas pa'i mdun sar 'gyod pas bshags/ 'dir 'bad dge bas tshogs gnyis chu gter bsrubs las mtha' dag gzugs can nyer 'thon pa'i// rgyal ba'i go 'phang sku bzhi'i bdag nyid rnyed dka'i bsam 'phel dbang*// mtshan dpe'i 'od rnon phyogs (434)brgyar 'bar ba'i gzi byin bkod dka' ldan// 'gro ba'i dad gsum thor tshugs rtse mor sgeg pa nyid gyur cig /ces rje btsun ma yid bzhin 'khor lo'i zab khrid thun mong ma yin pa'i yi ge bde ldan mgon po'i zhal lung ring 'tsho'i bsil sbyin zhes pa 'di'ang nges par thams cad mkhyen pa'i paṇḍi ta chen po rje btsun bla ma mkhyen brtse'i zhabs kyi bka' lung gser gyi cod pan spyi bo'i rgyan du lhung ba la brten nas/ rje btsun bla ma thugs rje chen po dang ldan pa rnams kyi zhabs kyi padmo la yan lag mchog gis btud pa rgyal khams kyi bya bral ba 'khyams po ngag dbang legs grub kyis yon tan rin po che du ma'i 'byung gnas dpal e waṃ chos ldan du khro mo'i lo dbo zla ba'i dkar phyogs kyi rgyal ba/

dang po'i nyin sbyar ba'i dge bas 'gro kun gzung 'dzin 'chi bdag gi g.yul las bi dza yantu// sarba dā ka lya ṇaṃ bha wa tu// ༈ /sgrol dkar tshe khrid 'chad thabs skal bzang rna ba'i dga' ston zhes bya ba bzhugs so// oṃ swa sti// bla ma mchog dang bde ldan mgon// tha dad min la gus btud nas// shin tu zab pa'i tshe khrid kyi// 'chad thabs dam pa'i gsung bzhin bri// de'i ji skad bshad pa'i mtshan nyid dang ldan pa'i slob dpon gyis skal pa dang ldan pa'i slob ma bdun las mi mang ba tshe khrid zab mo'i sgo nas rjes su 'dzin pa'i tshul ni// thog mar zla ba gang rung gi yar ngo'i tshes brgyad la gza' skar sbyor byed bzang po 'dzom pa'i nyin snga dror/ 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyug gis mdzad pa'i yig cha la zhal shes gsung sgros kyis brgyan pa'i rjes gnang thun mong ma yin pa gnang*/ dgongs ka'i dus su slob dpon gdan la 'khod nas bdud tshar bcad pa'i sngags tshar nyer gcig tsam bgrang*/ de nas slob ma rnams gral rim bzhin 'khod nas/ slob dpon nam gzhan zhig gis bskul te/ dpal ldan rtsa ba'i bla ma sogs shlau ka gcig (435)thub pa'i dbang po rje btsun sgrol ma'i zhabs// zhes gral gsham nas bsdus la phyag gsum btsal// 'greng bzhin pas/ dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ngo bo dpal ldan bla ma dam pa'i drung du dam pa'i chos kyi bka' khrid zab mo zhu ba'i yon du maṇḍal 'bul bar zhu/ zhes dang*/ oṃ badzra bhū mi sogs maṇḍal tshom bu so bdun ma 'bul/ spro na gong gi mchod rdzas ma dang*/ deng nas byang chub sogs kyang bya/ de nas slob dpon gyis zang zing med pa'i snying rje dang byang chub kyi sems sngon du 'gro bas skad gdangs mthon pos/ 'di skad ces brjod par bya'o// 'o nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad kyi don du rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang rin po che ci nas kyang thob par bya/

de'i ched du khrid kyi rim pa zab mo gsan snyam pa byang chub mchog tu thugs bskyed pa dang*/ chos gsan pa'i kun tu spyod pa yang*// skyes pa rabs kyi rgyud las// rab tu dma' ba'i stan la 'dug /dul ba'i dpal ni nye bar bzhag /dga' dang ldan pa'i mig gis blta// tshig gi bdud rtsi 'thung ba bzhin// gus pa bskyed de rtse gcig tu// rab tu dwangs la dri med yid// nad pas sman pa'i tshig nyan ltar// rim gro bskyed de chos nyon cig /ces dang*/ dkyil 'khor gyi chog rdo rje 'byung ba las/ rtog pa thams cad legs par bsdus nas ni// shin tu bsam pa bzang dang ldan nas nyon// brjed pas blo la rdo rje sems sogs dang*// bde bar gshegs pa rnams kyis byin mi rlobs// zhes gsungs pa ltar/ chos kyi tshig don la yid mi gtod pa snod kha sbubs lta bu'i skyon dang*/ yid gtad kyang dran pa dang shes bzhin gyis mi 'dzin pa snod zhabs rdol lta bu'i skyon dang*/ dran pa dang shes bzhin gyis bzung yang*/ rnam bshad rigs pa las// nga rgyal dang ni ma dad dang*// don du gnyer ba med nyid dang*// phyi rol rnam (436)g.yengs yid bsdus dang*// skyo ba nyan pa'i dri ma yin// zhes 'byung ba bzhin dri ma drug po gang rung dang ldan pa ni snod dri ma can gyi skyon te snod kyi skyon gsum spang dgos shing*/ khyad par tha mal snang zhen dang bcas pas gsang sngags zab mo'i chos nyan du mi rung bas/ sa phyogs 'di nyid kyang dag pa'i zhing khams bde ba can lta bur gyur pa'i dbus su/ rin po che'i khri padma dang zla ba'i gdan dang bcas pa'i steng du da lta chos ston mkhan gyi slob dpon kyang tha mal pa'i rnam pa 'di lta bu ma yin pa lhag pa'i lha rje btsun ma yid bzhin 'khor lo sku mtshan dang dpe byad kyis spras shing*/ gsung chos kyi sgra dbyangs grags stong gnyis su med pa lhang lhang sgrogs bzhin pa/

thugs rnams kun mchog ldan stong nyid kyi rgya mtsho chen po snying rje'i rba rlabs sogs long long du g.yo ba dngos yin snyam pa dang*/ khyed rnams kyang thun mtshams kyi lha gang yang rung ba'i nga rgyal dang ldan pa'i ngang nas yengs pa med pa'i tshul gyis gsan par zhu/ gang gsan par bya ba'i chos ni/ bdag cag 'gro ba yongs kyi sogs nas don dam pa'i sems bskyed yin zhes gsungs/ thun las ldang bar 'dod na/ dge ba'i rtsa ba 'dis mtshon dus gsum du bsags pa'i dge ba thams cad sems can thams cad dang thun mong du byas nas rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob par gyur cig snyam pas// dge ba 'di yis skye bo kun// zhes sogs bsngo ba dang smon lam rnam par dag pas rgyas btab la spyod lam thams cad du chos mthun gyi bya bas dus 'da' bar bya'o// slar yang thugs nges par bya ba'i slad du da dung lan cig bskyar na/ do nub rang rang gi gnas khang du bde ba'i stan la bsam gtan gyi chos dang ldan pas 'khod de/ dbugs rlung rngams bag rang zhir ma song gi bar ngal gso/ de nas brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs sngon du 'gro bas nyams len gyi rim pa la 'jug par ste/ de la'ang sngon 'gro dang dngos gzhi zhes (437)sogs nas/ dus 'da' bar bya'o// zhes pa'i bar gong bzhin bskyar/ slar yang thugs nges par bya ba'i phyir sogs nas/ dus 'da' bar bya'o zhes pa'i bar bskyar/ mthar/ de ring gi thugs dam de tsam la mdzad pa zhu/ bsod nams 'di yis sogs dang*/ theg mchog dam chos sogs smon lam mnyam du mdzad nas grol// nyin gnyis pa la/ slob dpon gyis tshe khrid rgyun gyi nyams len bzhes grub 'phral slob ma rnams bos te gral la 'khod nas brgyud 'debs maṇḍal sogs 'dra// 'o nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sogs nas/ don dam pa'i sems bskyed yin zhes gsungs/ zhes pa'i bar khar sang bzhin bskyar/ des khar sang gi dmigs pa song*/

de ring gi dmigs pa'i rim pa gsar du 'bul ba la/ gnyis pa thun mong ma yin pa'i sngon 'gro la zhes nas/ yun ring du bltas la zhes sogs gsungs pa'i phyir ro// zhes pa'i bar/ de las ldang bar 'dod na sgrub thabs kyi 'phro rnams dkyus bzhin nyams su blangs la dge ba'i rtsa ba sangs rgyas kyi rgyur bsngos la chos mthun gyi spyod pas dus 'da' bar bya'o// slar yang thugs nges par bya ba'i phyir da dung lan cig bskyar na/ do nub rang rang gi gnas khang du bde ba'i stan la bsam gtan gyi chos dang ldan pas 'khod de/ dbugs rlung rngam bag rang zhir ma song gi bar ngal gso/ de nas brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs sngon du 'gro bas nyams len gyi rim pa la 'jug par bya ste/ de la'ang sngon 'gro dngos gzhi rjes kyi rim pa ste gsum las thun mong gi sngon 'gro'i rim pa rnams song nas/ gnyis pa thun mong ma yin pa'i sngon 'gro zhes pa nas/ dus 'da' bar bya'o// zhes pa'i bar bskyal/ slar yang song nas de bzhin du bskyar mthar/ de ring gi thugs dam sogs 'dra// nyin gsum pa la/ gong 'og gzhan thams cad 'dra ba las/ 'o nam mkha' dang sogs nas/ sngon 'gro dang dngos gzhi dang rjes kyi rim pa ste gsum las thun mong gi sngon 'gro'i rim pa rnams ngos zin/ (438)gnyis pa thun mong ma yin pa'i sngon 'gro zhes pa nas/ yun ring du bltas la zhes sogs gsungs pa'i phyir ro// zhes pa'i bar bskyar/ des kha sang gi dmigs pa song*/ da de ring gi dmigs pa'i rim pa gsar du 'bul ba ni/ gnyis pa 'di nyid kyi thun mong ma yin pa'i dmigs pa la thugs ka'i 'khor lo sogs nas/ khyad par can ma thon gyi bar du 'bad par bya'o// thun las ldang bar 'dod na sgrub thabs kyi 'phros rnams dkyus bzhin nyams su blangs la/ dge ba'i rtsa ba sangs rgyas kyi rgyur bsngos la chos mthun gyi bya bas dus 'da' bar bya'o// slar yang thugs nges par bya ba'i phyir da dung lan gcig bskyar na/

do nub rang rang gi gnas khang du bde ba'i stan la bsam gtan gyi chos dang ldan pas 'khod de/ dbugs rlung rngam bag rang zhir ma song gi bar ngal gso/ de nas brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs sngon du 'gro bas nyams len gyi rim pa la 'jug par bya ste/ de la'ang sngon 'gro dngos gzhi rjes kyi rim pa ste gsum las thun mong du lha bsgom pa'i dmigs pa yan chad song zin nas/ gnyis pa 'di nyid kyi thun mong ma yin pa'i sogs nas/ dus 'da' bar bya'o zhes pa'i bar bskyar/ slar yang thugs nges par sogs nas/ dus 'da' bar bya'o zhes pa'i bar bskyar// de ring gi sogs 'dra// nyin bzhi pa la/ 'o nam mkha' dang sogs nas kha sang gi dmigs pa gong bzhin bskyar mthar/ des kha sang gi dmigs pa song*/ da de ring gi dmigs pa'i rim pa gsar du 'bul ba la/ bzhi pa tshe bcud bsdu ba ni// spyi bo'i bla ma tshe dpag med sogs nas/ kho nas dus 'da' bar bya'o zhes mjug rdzogs kyi bar bshad// slar yang thugs nges par bya ba'i phyir da dung lan gcig bskyar na/ do nub rang rang gi gnas khang bde ba'i stan la bsam gtan gyi chos dang ldan pas 'khod de/ dbugs rlung rngam bag rang zhir ma song gi bar ngal gso/ de nas brgyud pa'i (439)gsol 'debs sngon du 'gro bas nyams len gyi rim pa la 'jug par bya ste/ de la'ang sngon 'gro dngos gzhi rjes kyi rim pa ste gsum las srung 'khor bsgom pa yan chad song zin// bzhi pa tshe bcud bsdu ba ni/ spyi bo'i bla ma zhes pa nas 'da' bar bya'o// bar rdzogs par bskyar/ slar yang thugs nges par sogs nas/ dus 'da' bar bya'o zhes pa'i bar bskyar mthar/ de ring gi sogs 'dra// nyin lnga pa la/ snga dro'i dus su chos thun 'jug dgos kha sang gi dmigs pa bskyar mthar/ de rnams kyi sgo nas rje btsun ma yid bzhin 'khor lo'i sgo nas 'chi med tshe'i dngos grub sgrub pa'i gdams pa zab mo yongs su rdzogs pa kho bo cag gi rnam 'dren dam pa khyab bdag bde ldan mgon po dang dbyer ma mchis pa che ge mo'i zhal sgo nas ji ltar byon pa bzhin phul grub pa yin pas 'di la brten nas rang nyid kyi chos sgrub pa'i rten bzang yun ring du 'tsho ba'i thabs su/

thog mar bsnyen pa las su rung bar byas nas rgyun gyi nyams bzhes la brtson pa'i ngang nas rang gzhan gyi don du las kyi tshogs rab 'byams sgrub pa dang*/ skal ldan rnams gdams pas rjes su 'dzin pa la sogs pa bstan 'gro 'di go skabs su gang babs mdzad 'tshal// tshe khrid zab mo thob pa'i gtong rag tu maṇḍal phul// de ltar rang re rnams kyi dam pa'i chos nyan bshad byas pa la bsod nams dpag tu med pa zhig yod pa rnams bar mdor chud mi za ba'i phyir 'khor gsum mi dmigs pa'i bsngo bas rgyas gdab dgos pas/ zhes mtshams sbyar nas dbu zhwa phud/ phun sum tshogs pa'i dge 'dun sogs spyi bsngo rgyas pa shis brjod kyis mtha' brgyan par bya'o// de nas gnas skabs gang 'os zhig tu slob dpon ngag dbang grags pas mdzad pa'i sgrub thabs sogs rgya bod kyi gzhung lung rgyun gang bzhugs kyi bklag lung bya'o// slar smras pa// (440)'dir 'bad legs byas zla shel 'od// lus can snying gi ku mu dar// lhung ba tsam gyis sngon med pa'i// grub gnyis 'dab brgya grol gyur cig /ces pa 'di'ang rang nyid kyis sngar brtsams pa'i gzhung gi nyer mkhor rgyal khams pa wā gind+ra su siddhis sbyar ba shu bha mastu/
